blocks.en: The estimator handles outliers within one measurement; this layer handles anomalies between measurements. The reported value is the median of the last few accepted readings. The raw estimate is never overwritten — every gate decision is kept in the CSV and raw data, so you can re-run with different thresholds via tools/replay_od.py.
blocks.text: The estimator handles outliers within one measurement; this layer handles anomalies between measurements. The reported value is the median of the last few accepted readings. The raw estimate is never overwritten — every gate decision is kept in the CSV and raw data, so you can re-run with different thresholds via tools/replay_od.py.
blocks.zh: 估計器處理單次量測內的離群值，這一層處理量測之間的異常。回報值是最近幾筆被接受讀數的中位數。原始估計值不會被覆寫：每一次閘門判定都保留在 CSV 與原始數據中，因此可以用 tools/replay_od.py 以不同門檻重跑。

blocks.en: Press this before a planned operation: the next valid reading is taken as the new level immediately, without waiting for the confirm count and without being flagged as suspicious.
blocks.text: Press this before a planned operation: the next valid reading is taken as the new level immediately, without waiting for the confirm count and without being flagged as suspicious.
blocks.zh: 在預定的操作前按下此鈕：下一筆有效讀數會立即被當成新的液位，不必等確認次數，也不會被標記為可疑。

blocks.en: μ is the least-squares slope of ln(OD600 reported) against time, using gate-accepted readings only. It restarts after a declared operation, a confirmed level shift, a new blank or a different estimator.
blocks.text: μ is the least-squares slope of ln(OD600 reported) against time, using gate-accepted readings only. It restarts after a declared operation, a confirmed level shift, a new blank or a different estimator.
blocks.zh: μ 是 ln(OD600 回報值) 對時間的最小平方斜率，只採用通過閘門的讀數。宣告操作、確認液位變動、重新校正空白值或更換估計器後，μ 會重新開始累積。

blocks.en: Load clean media / a blank sample into the flow cuvette before pressing "Calibrate Blank" — it sets the current reading as OD600 = 0. Takes about 3 s to take effect.
blocks.text: Load clean media / a blank sample into the flow cuvette before pressing "Calibrate Blank" — it sets the current reading as OD600 = 0. Takes about 3 s to take effect.
blocks.zh: 按「校正空白值」前，先把乾淨培養液或空白樣品灌入流通池：此操作會把目前讀數設為 OD600 = 0。約 3 s 後生效。

blocks.en: Forces the LED continuously ON (instead of the measurement-only pulses) and shows live, unfiltered sample/reference readings so you can watch the ratio while adjusting the optics. OD600 measurement and logging are paused while active. If this page stops polling for 30 s the board exits engineering mode on its own.
blocks.text: Forces the LED continuously ON (instead of the measurement-only pulses) and shows live, unfiltered sample/reference readings so you can watch the ratio while adjusting the optics. blocks.zh: 強制 LED 持續開啟（而不是只在量測時脈衝），並顯示未經濾波的即時樣品／參考讀數，讓你在調整光路時能同時看比值。啟動期間 OD600 量測與記錄都暫停。若本頁停止輪詢達 30 s，板端會自行離開工程模式。

blocks.en: Automatic MCU reboot has been removed: on the UNO Q, after a software reset the MCU does not reconnect to the Bridge and only stopping the App or a power cycle recovers it. If the command channel stalls, the red banner appears; stop and restart the App in App Lab, and if that fails unplug the UNO Q for 10 s.
blocks.text: Automatic MCU reboot has been removed: on the UNO Q, after a software reset the MCU does not reconnect to the Bridge and only stopping the App or a power cycle recovers it. If the command channel stalls, the red banner appears; stop and restart the App in App Lab, and if that fails unplug the UNO Q for 10 s.
blocks.zh: 自動重啟 MCU 的功能已移除：在 UNO Q 上，軟體重置後 MCU 不會重新連上 Bridge，只有停止 App 或重新上電才能恢復。若命令通道停滯，紅色橫幅會出現；請在 App Lab 停止並重新啟動 App，若仍無效就把 UNO Q 拔掉 10 s。

blocks.en: Stress test: many parallel read calls; all must succeed. Python-side outage: every call fails for 30 s; the red banner should appear and clear afterwards.

blocks.en: When pH drops below target − deadband a cycle starts: feed valve to Base → the feed pump doses once at the dosing PWM → wait for mixing to settle (slope below the set value) → dose again while still below target; at target the feed valve returns to where it was. High pH only raises an alarm (no acid). Auto pH pauses while the feed pump runs manually. Several doses in a row with no pH rise (base empty, line blocked) latch a FAULT.
blocks.text: When pH drops below target − deadband a cycle starts: feed valve to Base → the feed pump doses once at the dosing PWM → wait for mixing to settle (slope below the set value) → dose again while still below target; at target the feed valve returns to where it was. High pH only raises an alarm (no acid). Auto pH pauses while the feed pump runs manually. Several doses in a row with no pH rise (base empty, line blocked) latch a FAULT.
blocks.zh: 當 pH 低於目標 − 死區時啟動一個循環：進料閥切到鹼液 → 進料幫浦以加藥 PWM 加藥一次 → 等混合穩定（斜率低於設定值）→ 若仍低於目標就再加一次；到達目標後進料閥回到原本位置。pH 過高只會發出警報（不加酸）。手動運轉進料幫浦期間，自動 pH 控制暫停。連續數次加藥都沒有 pH 上升（鹼液用盡、管路阻塞）會鎖存 FAULT。

blocks.en: Manual dosing only works while the feed valve is set to Base (switch it under Pump › Feed valve & feed pump), and not while the feed pump runs.
blocks.text: Manual dosing only works while the feed valve is set to Base (switch it under Pump › Feed valve & feed pump), and not while the feed pump runs.
blocks.zh: 手動加藥只在進料閥切到鹼液時有效（請到幫浦 › 進料閥與進料幫浦切換），且進料幫浦運轉期間無法使用。

blocks.en: Manual dosing no longer turns the feed valve: set the feed valve to Base first, then press Dose once. The dosing PWM and hourly limit apply to both auto pH and manual dosing; the MCU also refuses to dose unless the feed valve is at Base, the pressure trip is clear and the hourly limit is not exceeded.
blocks.text: Manual dosing no longer turns the feed valve: set the feed valve to Base first, then press Dose once. The dosing PWM and hourly limit apply to both auto pH and manual dosing; the MCU also refuses to dose unless the feed valve is at Base, the pressure trip is clear and the hourly limit is not exceeded.
blocks.zh: 手動加藥不再自動轉動進料閥：請先把進料閥切到鹼液，再按「加藥一次」。加藥 PWM 與每小時上限同時適用於自動 pH 與手動加藥；此外，除非進料閥在鹼液位置、壓力跳脫已解除且未超過每小時上限，MCU 都會拒絕加藥。

blocks.en: τ_w is about 1.4–4.2 Pa in operation (γ 2000–6000 s⁻¹). Measured on this rig: Bacillus subtilis still grew to OD600 3.5 at 6000 s⁻¹ and kept secreting protein for 60+ hours. The γ upper limit of 11 000 s⁻¹ is the laminar-model limit (Re < 2000), not a cell-tolerance limit — above it, γ_flow = 8v/d and τ_w themselves stop being valid.
blocks.text: τ_w is about 1.4–4.2 Pa in operation (γ 2000–6000 s⁻¹). Measured on this rig: Bacillus subtilis still grew to OD600 3.5 at 6000 s⁻¹ and kept secreting protein for 60+ hours. The γ upper limit of 11 000 s⁻¹ is the laminar-model limit (Re < 2000), not a cell-tolerance limit — above it, γ_flow = 8v/d and τ_w themselves stop being valid.
blocks.zh: 運轉時 τ_w 約為 1.4–4.2 Pa（γ 2000–6000 s⁻¹）。本機實測：枯草桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）在 6000 s⁻¹ 下仍長到 OD600 3.5，並持續分泌蛋白質超過 60 小時。γ 的上限 11 000 s⁻¹ 是層流模型的極限（Re < 2000），不是細胞耐受的極限；超過它之後，γ_flow = 8v/d 與 τ_w 本身就不再成立。
Q_perm 由收集量 ÷ 時間計算

blocks.en: Q_L comes from the flow meter by default; switch to "Manual" if the meter is inaccurate or absent, and all derived values (γ, Re, ΔP ratio) use the manual value. Q_perm feeds J, L_p and D; culture volume feeds D (also editable under Specs). The ΔP–Q sweep always uses the flow meter.
blocks.text: Q_L comes from the flow meter by default; switch to "Manual" if the meter is inaccurate or absent, and all derived values (γ, Re, ΔP ratio) use the manual value. Q_perm feeds J, L_p and D; culture volume feeds D (also editable under Specs). The ΔP–Q sweep always uses the flow meter.
blocks.zh: Q_L 預設取自流量計；若流量計不準或沒有安裝，請切到「手動」，所有衍生值（γ、Re、ΔP 比值）都會改用手動值。Q_perm 供 J、L_p 與 D 使用；培養體積供 D 使用（也可在「規格」中編輯）。ΔP–Q 掃描一律使用流量計。

blocks.en: Stop the pump first (PWM = 0). The system waits 10 s for flow to decay, then records 30 s; the reading must be a stable plateau, otherwise it keeps waiting (up to 3 min). Redo after every re-assembly of the tubing.
blocks.text: Stop the pump first (PWM = 0). The system waits 10 s for flow to decay, then records 30 s; the reading must be a stable plateau, otherwise it keeps waiting (up to 3 min). Redo after every re-assembly of the tubing.

blocks.en: ΔP baseline = a·Q + b·Q² (quadratic ΔP–Q calibration through the origin). Before the scale is installed, Q_perm can be computed by weighing the collection bottle (g/min ≈ mL/min). The L_p initial value is captured automatically the first time L_p can be computed.
blocks.text: ΔP baseline = a·Q + b·Q² (quadratic ΔP–Q calibration through the origin). Before the scale is installed, Q_perm can be computed by weighing the collection bottle (g/min ≈ mL/min). The L_p initial value is captured automatically the first time L_p can be computed.
blocks.zh: ΔP 基準 = a·Q + b·Q²（過原點的二次 ΔP–Q 校正）。在磅秤安裝之前，Q_perm 可以用收集瓶秤重算出（g/min ≈ mL/min）。L_p 初始值會在第一次能算出 L_p 時自動記下。

blocks.en: Zero the pressures and run the ρgh self-test first; use a clean membrane with the valve open. The pump steps through the PWM values below (high → low by default, so low PWMs are reached while already running instead of starting from rest); at each point the average ΔP_friction and flow are recorded after settling, then ΔP = a·Q + b·Q² is fitted. The original PWM is restored afterwards. Changing the PWM manually or emergency stop aborts the sweep.
blocks.text: Zero the pressures and run the ρgh self-test first; use a clean membrane with the valve open. The pump steps through the PWM values below (high → low by default, so low PWMs are reached while already running instead of starting from rest); at each point the average ΔP_friction and flow are recorded after settling, then ΔP = a·Q + b·Q² is fitted. The original PWM is restored afterwards. Changing the PWM manually or emergency stop aborts the sweep.
blocks.zh: 請先把壓力歸零並跑過 ρgh 自我測試；使用乾淨的薄膜，並讓閥保持開啟。幫浦會依下列 PWM 值逐點變化（預設由高到低，讓低 PWM 是在幫浦已經運轉時到達，而不是從靜止起步）；每一點在穩定後記錄 ΔP_friction 與流量的平均值，再擬合 ΔP = a·Q + b·Q²。結束後會回復原本的 PWM。手動改動 PWM 或緊急停止都會中止掃描。

blocks.en: cycle_freq_hz is a rough zero-crossing estimate for comparison against an oscilloscope only, not a precise value.
blocks.text: cycle_freq_hz is a rough zero-crossing estimate for comparison against an oscilloscope only, not a precise value.

blocks.en: A stopped pump has static friction, so a low PWM may not start it, yet it keeps running once moving. When enabled, starting from stop first runs at the kick PWM for a short time, then drops to your PWM.
blocks.text: A stopped pump has static friction, so a low PWM may not start it, yet it keeps running once moving. When enabled, starting from stop first runs at the kick PWM for a short time, then drops to your PWM.
blocks.zh: 停止中的幫浦有靜摩擦，低 PWM 可能啟動不了，但一旦轉起來就能持續運轉。啟用後，從靜止起步會先以衝擊 PWM 短暫運轉，再降到你設定的 PWM。

blocks.en: Measure the UNO Q header against GND with a meter: "IN3 (D12) high" for D12, "IN4 (D13) high" for D13, about 3.3 V each; then the IN3 / IN4 terminals on the L298N. The test switches off by itself when the time is up, and the main pump emergency stop also ends it.
blocks.text: Measure the UNO Q header against GND with a meter: "IN3 (D12) high" for D12, "IN4 (D13) high" for D13, about 3.3 V each; then the IN3 / IN4 terminals on the L298N. The test switches off by itself when the time is up, and the main pump emergency stop also ends it.
blocks.zh: 用萬用電表以 GND 為基準量測 UNO Q 排針：按「IN3（D12）拉高」量 D12，按「IN4（D13）拉高」量 D13，各約 3.3 V；接著量 L298N 上的 IN3 / IN4 端子。時間到測試會自行關閉，主幫浦緊急停止也會結束測試。

blocks.en: What is pumped is chosen by the feed valve (Base / External feed). One direction only: driven by IN4 (D13) with IN3 (D12) held LOW (D12 cannot drive on the board); if the liquid flows the wrong way, swap the two motor wires on OUT3 / OUT4. Wiring: ENB = D11, IN3 = D12, IN4 = D13 (remove the ENB jumper on the L298N). The pump will not run while the feed valve is fully closed, the pressure trip is latched or after an emergency stop; auto pH pauses while it runs.
blocks.text: What is pumped is chosen by the feed valve (Base / External feed). One direction only: driven by IN4 (D13) with IN3 (D12) held LOW (D12 cannot drive on the board); if the liquid flows the wrong way, swap the two motor wires on OUT3 / OUT4. Wiring: ENB = D11, IN3 = D12, IN4 = D13 (remove the ENB jumper on the L298N). The pump will not run while the feed valve is fully closed, the pressure trip is latched or after an emergency stop; auto pH pauses while it runs.
blocks.zh: 抽送什麼由進料閥決定（鹼液／外部進料）。只有單一方向：由 IN4（D13）驅動，IN3（D12）維持 LOW（板上 D12 無法驅動）；若液體流向相反，請把 OUT3 / OUT4 上的兩條馬達線對調。配線：ENB = D11、IN3 = D12、IN4 = D13（請拔掉 L298N 上的 ENB 跳線）。進料閥完全關閉、壓力跳脫鎖存中或緊急停止之後，幫浦都不會運轉；幫浦運轉期間自動 pH 控制暫停。

blocks.en: Pinch position not set: open "Valve setup" below, move the servo to where it just pinches the tube, and press "Save as pinched".
blocks.text: Pinch position not set: open "Valve setup" below, move the servo to where it just pinches the tube, and press "Save as pinched".
blocks.zh: 尚未設定夾緊位置：請打開下方的「閥設定」，把伺服轉到剛好夾住管子的位置，再按「存為夾緊」。

blocks.en: Unplug the driver board and connect UNO Q D0 directly to D1 with one jumper wire, then press. This tests only the UNO Q D0/D1 transmit/receive, independent of the driver board and servo.
blocks.text: Unplug the driver board and connect UNO Q D0 directly to D1 with one jumper wire, then press. This tests only the UNO Q D0/D1 transmit/receive, independent of the driver board and servo.
blocks.zh: 請拔掉驅動板，用一條跳線把 UNO Q 的 D0 直接接到 D1，再按下此鈕。這只測 UNO Q 的 D0/D1 收發，與驅動板和伺服無關。

blocks.en: No reply needed: sends a move command to the broadcast ID at all 8 baud rates. Servo moves → the transmit path (D1/TX) and power are fine; the problem is the reply path (D0/RX) or swapped TX/RX. Servo does not move → check the D1/TX wire, jumper, driver-board power and servo cable. Remove the tube from the clamp first.
blocks.text: No reply needed: sends a move command to the broadcast ID at all 8 baud rates. Servo moves → the transmit path (D1/TX) and power are fine; the problem is the reply path (D0/RX) or swapped TX/RX. Servo does not move → check the D1/TX wire, jumper, driver-board power and servo cable. Remove the tube from the clamp first.
blocks.zh: 不需要回覆：以全部 8 種鮑率對廣播 ID 送出移動命令。伺服會動 → 發送路徑（D1/TX）與電源正常，問題在回覆路徑（D0/RX）或 TX/RX 接反。伺服不動 → 請檢查 D1/TX 線、跳線、驅動板電源與伺服線。請先把管子從夾具中取出。

blocks.en: Tries 8 baud rates (1M, 500k, 250k, 128k, 115200, 76800, 57600, 38400) with a broadcast ping each; the full scan also tries IDs 0–253. Press "Use" on a result to switch to that ID and baud (saved). The valve must be open while scanning.
blocks.text: Tries 8 baud rates (1M, 500k, 250k, 128k, 115200, 76800, 57600, 38400) with a broadcast ping each; the full scan also tries IDs 0–253. Press "Use" on a result to switch to that ID and baud (saved). The valve must be open while scanning.
blocks.zh: 會逐一試 8 種鮑率（1M、500k、250k、128k、115200、76800、57600、38400），每種都送一次廣播 ping；完整掃描還會試 ID 0–253。在結果上按「使用」即可切到該 ID 與鮑率（會儲存）。掃描期間閥必須保持開啟。

blocks.en: Finding positions: turn torque off and rotate the clamp by hand until the tube is just flattened → "Save as pinched"; rotate back clear of the tube → "Save as open". Or approach with the number / ±20 buttons. The torque limit reduces clamp force and servo heating. TMP / Feed limits are checked by the MCU every 200 ms on instantaneous peaks; exceeding them releases and locks the valve even if Linux is down.
blocks.text: Finding positions: turn torque off and rotate the clamp by hand until the tube is just flattened → "Save as pinched"; rotate back clear of the tube → "Save as open". Or approach with the number / ±20 buttons. The torque limit reduces clamp force and servo heating. TMP / Feed limits are checked by the MCU every 200 ms on instantaneous peaks; exceeding them releases and locks the valve even if Linux is down.
blocks.zh: 找位置的方法：關閉扭力，用手轉動夾具直到管子剛好被壓扁 → 按「存為夾緊」；再轉回完全離開管子 → 按「存為開啟」。也可以用數字或 ±20 按鈕慢慢靠近。扭力上限可降低夾持力與伺服發熱。TMP／進料上限由 MCU 每 200 ms 以瞬時峰值檢查；超過上限就會鬆開並鎖住閥，即使 Linux 當機也一樣。

blocks.en: Sampling & feed valve setup (positions / servo ID)
blocks.text: Sampling & feed valve setup (positions / servo ID)
blocks.zh: 取樣閥與進料閥設定（位置／伺服 ID）

blocks.en: Change servo ID (new servos ship as ID 1)
blocks.text: Change servo ID (new servos ship as ID 1)
blocks.zh: 變更伺服 ID（新伺服出廠為 ID 1）

blocks.en: Only one "ID 1" may be on the bus at a time. Connect new servos one by one: with only the new servo connected (pinch valve unplugged), change ID 1 to 2 (shell valve) or 3 (feed valve), then connect the next one. The ID is stored in the servo EEPROM.
blocks.text: Only one "ID 1" may be on the bus at a time. Connect new servos one by one: with only the new servo connected (pinch valve unplugged), change ID 1 to 2 (shell valve) or 3 (feed valve), then connect the next one. The ID is stored in the servo EEPROM.
blocks.zh: 匯流排上同一時間只能有一個「ID 1」。請一個一個接上新伺服：只接新伺服（夾管閥先拔掉），把 ID 1 改成 2（殼側閥）或 3（進料閥），再接下一個。ID 存在伺服的 EEPROM 中。

blocks.en: Default positions are from angles (0–360° → 0–4095): shell closed 315° = 3584, sensor 270° = 3072, open 0° = 0; feed closed 315° = 3584, base 270° = 3072, external feed 180° = 2048. If the mounting is off, turn by hand (torque off) or jog, then press "Save position".
blocks.text: Default positions are from angles (0–360° → 0–4095): shell closed 315° = 3584, sensor 270° = 3072, open 0° = 0; feed closed 315° = 3584, base 270° = 3072, external feed 180° = 2048. If the mounting is off, turn by hand (torque off) or jog, then press "Save position".
blocks.zh: 預設位置由角度換算（0–360° → 0–4095）：殼側閥關閉 315° = 3584、通往感測器 270° = 3072、開啟 0° = 0；進料閥關閉 315° = 3584、鹼液 270° = 3072、外部進料 180° = 2048。若安裝角度有偏差，請手動轉動（先關閉扭力）或用微調按鈕，再按「儲存位置」。

blocks.en: Recording runs entirely on the board: every sampling window is written straight to a CSV in the board's recordings/ folder as soon as it closes. Sleeping the computer, closing the browser, even restarting the App will not interrupt it — the browser is only the control surface. Each row holds OD600 (AU), flow (mL/min), pressure (bar), pump PWM and all derived parameters.
blocks.text: Recording runs entirely on the board: every sampling window is written straight to a CSV in the board's recordings/ folder as soon as it closes. Sleeping the computer, closing the browser, even restarting the App will not interrupt it — the browser is only the control surface. Each row holds OD600 (AU), flow (mL/min), pressure (bar), pump PWM and all derived parameters.
blocks.zh: 記錄完全在板端執行：每個取樣視窗一結束就直接寫進板上 recordings/ 資料夾裡的 CSV。電腦睡眠、關掉瀏覽器，甚至重新啟動 App 都不會中斷它；瀏覽器只是操作介面。每一列包含 OD600（AU）、流量（mL/min）、壓力（bar）、幫浦 PWM 與所有衍生參數。

blocks.en: Pressure and flow are sampled continuously over this window; at the end of each window a single median/mean is taken and becomes the on-screen value, one chart point and one CSV row. The same duration is also the OD600 measurement interval, so all three signals stay aligned. Safety alerts on the instantaneous TMP peak/trough are unaffected and still update every 200 ms.
blocks.text: Pressure and flow are sampled continuously over this window; at the end of each window a single median/mean is taken and becomes the on-screen value, one chart point and one CSV row. The same duration is also the OD600 measurement interval, so all three signals stay aligned. Safety alerts on the instantaneous TMP peak/trough are unaffected and still update every 200 ms.
blocks.zh: 壓力與流量會在這個視窗內連續取樣；每個視窗結束時取一個中位數／平均值，成為畫面上的數值、圖表上的一點與 CSV 的一列。同樣的長度也是 OD600 的量測間隔，因此三個訊號始終對齊。以瞬時 TMP 峰值／波谷為準的安全警示不受影響，仍每 200 ms 更新。

blocks.en: Since v5.0 every algorithm runs in Python: a change takes effect immediately and is saved; OD600 is recomputed at once from the last raw readings. All 8 OD600 algorithms are computed every time and written to the CSV (od_mad … od_p90); raw readings are kept in the recording's _raw folder and can be replayed with tools/replay_od.py. Each CSV row records the active combination in alg_profile. Changing steady-state or analysis source restarts the steady/trend accumulation.
blocks.text: Since v5.0 every algorithm runs in Python: a change takes effect immediately and is saved; OD600 is recomputed at once from the last raw readings. All 8 OD600 algorithms are computed every time and written to the CSV (od_mad … od_p90); raw readings are kept in the recording's _raw folder and can be replayed with tools/replay_od.py. Each CSV row records the active combination in alg_profile. Changing steady-state or analysis source restarts the steady/trend accumulation.
blocks.zh: 自 v5.0 起所有演算法都在 Python 中執行：變更立即生效並儲存，OD600 會馬上用最近的原始讀數重新計算。8 種 OD600 演算法每次都會全部計算並寫入 CSV（od_mad … od_p90）；原始讀數保存在該筆記錄的 _raw 資料夾，可用 tools/replay_od.py 重播。每一列 CSV 都在 alg_profile 記下當時採用的組合。變更穩態判定或分析來源會讓穩態／趨勢的累積重新開始。

blocks.en: Export saves the OD600 blank, pressure zero offsets, path-length factor, pH calibration, ρgh / ΔP–Q baseline, Q_perm, valve settings and specs currently in effect to one .json file. Import reads a previously exported file and writes the selected items back to the board.
blocks.text: Export saves the OD600 blank, pressure zero offsets, path-length factor, pH calibration, ρgh / ΔP–Q baseline, Q_perm, valve settings and specs currently in effect to one .json file. Import reads a previously exported file and writes the selected items back to the board.
blocks.zh: 匯出會把目前生效的 OD600 空白值、壓力歸零偏移、光程係數、pH 校正、ρgh / ΔP–Q 基準、Q_perm、閥設定與規格一併存成一個 .json 檔。匯入則讀取先前匯出的檔案，把選取的項目寫回板端。

blocks.en: Since v5.0 the OD600 blank, pressure zero offsets, path length factor and pH calibration live on the board's Linux side (calibration_state.json, ph_valve_state.json) and all conversions happen there, so an MCU reboot loses nothing; only the pressure zeros used by the valve safety interlock are pushed to the MCU automatically. You can also enter your own recorded values below; whenever the zeros in effect were not measured on the spot, a warning stays visible at the top of the page.
blocks.text: Since v5.0 the OD600 blank, pressure zero offsets, path length factor and pH calibration live on the board's Linux side (calibration_state.json, ph_valve_state.json) and all conversions happen there, so an MCU reboot loses nothing; only the pressure zeros used by the valve safety interlock are pushed to the MCU automatically. You can also enter your own recorded values below; whenever the zeros in effect were not measured on the spot, a warning stays visible at the top of the page.
blocks.zh: 自 v5.0 起，OD600 空白值、壓力歸零偏移、光程係數與 pH 校正都存在板端的 Linux 側（calibration_state.json、ph_valve_state.json），所有換算也在那裡進行，因此 MCU 重啟不會遺失任何設定；只有閥安全連鎖所用的壓力零點會自動推送到 MCU。你也可以在下方自行輸入抄錄的數值；只要生效的零點不是當場量測的，頁面頂端就會持續顯示警告。

blocks.en: The blank ratio alone is enough — it is the only value used in the calculation. You can also enter just the sample and reference lux and let the system compute the ratio. The two lux values only affect the display.
blocks.text: The blank ratio alone is enough — it is the only value used in the calculation. You can also enter just the sample and reference lux and let the system compute the ratio. The two lux values only affect the display.
blocks.zh: 只填空白比值就夠了，計算只會用到它。你也可以只輸入樣品與參考的 lux 值，讓系統自行算出比值。那兩個 lux 值只影響顯示。
壓力歸零偏移（手動輸入，bar）

blocks.en: Same values that "Zero calibrate" produces. Use "Read current values" above to fill these fields with what is in effect now, so you can note them down.
blocks.text: Same values that "Zero calibrate" produces. Use "Read current values" above to fill these fields with what is in effect now, so you can note them down.
blocks.zh: 與「歸零校正」所產生的數值相同。按上方的「讀取目前數值」可把目前生效的值填入這些欄位，方便抄錄。
pH 兩點校正（手動輸入）
使用溫度計

blocks.en: Raw probe voltages (after the on-board amplifier) in the pH 7.00 and pH 4.01 buffers, and the buffer temperature at calibration. "Read current values" above fills these fields with the values in effect now; manually applied values are saved and pushed back after an MCU reboot.
blocks.text: Raw probe voltages (after the on-board amplifier) in the pH 7.00 and pH 4.01 buffers, and the buffer temperature at calibration. "Read current values" above fills these fields with the values in effect now; manually applied values are saved and pushed back after an MCU reboot.
blocks.zh: 在 pH 7.00 與 pH 4.01 緩衝液中的探頭原始電壓（經板載放大器之後），以及校正當時的緩衝液溫度。按上方的「讀取目前數值」會把目前生效的值填入這些欄位；手動套用的數值會被儲存，並在 MCU 重啟後重新推送回去。

blocks.en: Module specs and thresholds used to compute the derived parameters. Changes take effect immediately and are saved (kept across App restarts); "Reset to defaults" returns to constants.json. Fields marked ● differ from the default.
blocks.text: Module specs and thresholds used to compute the derived parameters. Changes take effect immediately and are saved (kept across App restarts); "Reset to defaults" returns to constants.json. Fields marked ● differ from the default.
blocks.zh: 用來計算衍生參數的模組規格與門檻。變更立即生效並儲存（App 重啟後仍保留）；按「回復預設值」會回到 constants.json。標有 ● 的欄位與預設值不同。

blocks.en: Compute A and V_lumen from geometry
blocks.text: Compute A and V_lumen from geometry
blocks.zh: 由幾何計算 A 與 V_lumen

blocks.en: Tick the items to apply. OD600 blank and pressure zero are written to the MCU (marked "entered manually"; the yellow banner reminds you to confirm they still match the current plumbing).
blocks.text: Tick the items to apply. OD600 blank and pressure zero are written to the MCU (marked "entered manually"; the yellow banner reminds you to confirm they still match the current plumbing).
blocks.zh: 勾選要套用的項目。OD600 空白值與壓力零點會寫入 MCU（標記為「手動輸入」；黃色橫幅會提醒你確認它們仍符合目前的管路配置）。

attrs.en: Display mode: desktop (full layout) / local touch screen (tabs)
attrs.zh: 顯示模式：桌機（完整版面）／本機觸控螢幕（分頁）

attrs.en: Open the temperature trend and manual input
attrs.zh: 開啟溫度趨勢與手動輸入

attrs.en: Every 10 ms the MCU checks Feed / Retentate / Permeate; if any exceeds the limit for 50 ms it immediately stops the main pump and base pump, releases the pinch valve and latches. While latched the main pump cannot start; once pressure is below the limit press "Clear pressure trip", then Apply on the pump panel. Works even if Linux hangs.
attrs.zh: MCU 每 10 ms 檢查進料／截留液／透過液；任一路超過上限並持續 50 ms，就立即停止主幫浦與鹼液幫浦、鬆開夾管閥並鎖存。鎖存期間主幫浦無法啟動；壓力降到上限以下後按「解除壓力跳脫」，再在幫浦面板按套用。即使 Linux 當機也有效。
